text: SLICE 4 — THE HOLD I SHIPPED YESTERDAY WOULD HAVE EVAPORATED. SHA ba2c52b6818ca4b628bd1bd58fe73cdd9e8c61bb on fable/catalog-action-unification-20260820, rebased on e199b18, pushed. SELF-CAUGHT DEFECT: my formulation hold matched the phrase 'split pending' in the variant specification. Your reviewed reconciliation sets the CANONICAL specification for GRP-0422 to 'CJC-1295 WITH DAC + IPAMORELIN 5 mg total' - marker removed, correctly, since a customer should not read our internal uncertainty in a product name. So my rule would have stopped matching at exactly the moment the reconciled row entered the catalog: the hold evaporates as the product appears, and every test written against the workbook text still passes. Found by reading your config rather than trusting my own green suite. FIX: the hold now reads config/research/master-catalog-reconciliation-*.json directly, so your record's own promise - 'Removing this entry is all that is needed to release it. No storefront change, no code change' - is literally true. A test proves the release path: empty the hold set and the row is purchasable again. An unreadable record THROWS rather than answering 'nothing is held'. The declared marker survives as a second line for raw un-reconciled rows; it can only add a hold, never remove one. THIS PARTLY ANSWERS THE PEER P0 (applyCatalogReconciliation has no production caller, so nothing applies the GRP-0422 hold in the running system): for the master-offerings action path the hold is now applied WITHOUT depending on artifact regeneration or on the reconciler being wired, because it reads the reviewed record at composition time. The remaining half is yours and real: the member-safe artifact still carries 420/135 with no hold field, and applyCatalogReconciliation still has no production caller, so the duplicate collapse (Hexarelin 5mg, Oxytocin 10mg) is NOT applied anywhere in the running system. COMPOSITION REQUIREMENT: pass reviewedHeldSpecifications() from server/research/master-offerings/reviewed-holds.ts as capabilities.reviewedFormulationHolds where you build the master-offerings action. Without it the reviewed hold is invisible to that resolver. ALSO FIXED, pre-existing and verified against a clean base: the two pricing-grant-boundary audits scan every source file and raced vitest's 5s default, so that security gate was failing at random. They now declare a budget. NOT BROADENED: standalone WITH DAC 2mg/5mg stay DIRECT, 10mg stays Request Order, pinned by test.
